svg.title: Build rhythm — when the code actually ships
svg.desc: 1642 commits across 39 public repositories, bucketed by hour and weekday in IST. Chronotype Night Owl: 38% of my commits land between 22:00 and 05:00 IST. Peak hour 00:00 with 111 commits. Focus window 23:00 to 02:00 with 317 commits. 29% after midnight, 34% on weekends. Busiest weekday Thursday with 290 commits; busiest slot Tuesday 20:00 with 47 commits. 158 active days since June 2025. Deepest session 10h 14m with 41 commits, mostly in Multimodal Evidence Console. Newest commit: github-ranking, "Rank every imported team: no usable GitHub scores 0; Teams page shows…", 16 Nov 2026 12:12 IST. Synced 2026-11-17 15:43 IST.
